name: Jasperino De Pipino
title: The Hungarian Warrior
description: Claims to be a noble Hungarian warrior, but he's actually just a guy from the Barangay who eats Hungarian sausage dipped in cheese. He insists his martial arts style was passed down by European Warriors, but his signature move is just aggressive slap fighting over who gets the last piece of Hungarian Sausage.

name: ShiroTabi
title: Derp Destroyer
description: Don't let that completely motionless face or his silly, unpredictable antics fool you ShiroTabi is an absolute force on the battlefield.

name: Ironhand
title: The Unbroken Vessel
description: Once fighting out of pure bitterness and believing only in raw strength, Ironhand's world shattered when his own power failed him during a near-fatal trial. Saved by an unearned grace, he emerged as a Warrior of Light guided by humility, quiet respect, and steadfast protection rather than force. Before battle, he kneels, strikes his iron fist to the ground, and prays "Oh Heavenly Father, bear witness as I show you the strength of your creation."
